requirements.desc: Every sdd-forge flow command group except flow get runtime-log shall open a runtime log block before command execution and close it after success or failure.
requirements.note: R1: flow get status opens and closes an automatic runtime log block

requirements.desc: Runtime log blocks shall be appended to .tmp/logs/<flowId>.log, with flowId derived from the active flow spec id or no-flow when no active flow exists.
requirements.note: R2: active-flow and no-flow commands append to the required root .tmp log files

requirements.desc: The sequence value shall be assigned by counting existing start blocks in the target log file before appending the new block.
requirements.note: R3: repeated commands append increasing sequence blocks to the same log file

requirements.desc: Each runtime log block shall include start and end records containing runId, sequence, attempt, command, startedAt, endedAt, and exitCode.
requirements.note: R4: runtime log blocks record complete command metadata and exit code

requirements.desc: stdout and stderr writes shall be copied into the same block in observed write order, with each emitted line prefixed [stdout] or [stderr], while preserving the original stdout/stderr streams.
requirements.note: R5: runtime logs tee stdout and stderr with prefixes while preserving visible streams

requirements.desc: Step-associated commands shall persist runtimeLog metadata on their workflow step without storing file names or paths, except finalize-cleanup which is excluded because it commits and removes flow state before dispatcher finalization.
requirements.note: R6: step-associated commands persist path-free runtimeLog metadata and exclude finalize-cleanup

requirements.desc: Non-step flow commands shall not add runtimeLog metadata to flow.json; on failure they shall expose runtimeLog.runId and runtimeLog.sequence in the envelope or stderr.
requirements.note: R7: failed non-step commands expose runtimeLog identifiers without step metadata

requirements.desc: sdd-forge flow get runtime-log shall return the selected block as raw stdout by default and shall return an envelope containing text, runId, sequence, command, startedAt, endedAt, and exitCode when --format json is supplied.
requirements.note: R8: flow get runtime-log returns raw text and JSON envelope output

requirements.desc: flow get runtime-log shall select the latest non-runtime-log block for the active flow by default, select .tmp/logs/no-flow.log when no active flow exists, support --sequence <n>, and support --run-id <runId>#<sequence>.
requirements.note: R9: flow get runtime-log selects latest, sequence, run-id, and no-flow blocks

requirements.desc: --log-file shall be removed from flow run argument parsing, command help, generated skills, source skills, and tests.
requirements.note: R10: --log-file is removed from registry, help, source skills, generated skills, and tests

requirements.desc: Tests shall cover stdout/stderr capture for prepare, get, set, run, and report show paths, metadata persistence for step-associated commands, non-step failure runtimeLog exposure, runtime-log retrieval, and --log-file removal.
requirements.note: R12: prepare, get, set, run, and report show paths preserve and log stderr

requirements.desc: flow report show failures shall return or throw through the dispatcher instead of calling process.exit directly, so runtime log blocks close with endedAt and exitCode.
requirements.note: R13: flow report show failures return through dispatcher and close runtime logs
